issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Coldtea.ai
products.tagline: Make your software self-driving
products.summaryZh: 让你的软件实现自动驾驶。
products.descriptionZh: 团队使用AI交付速度越快，生产环境稳定性就越难保障。但现在不同了。Coldtea是一款智能代理IDE，在这里，你的编码代理负责构建，视觉质量保证代理捕捉回归问题，AI监控则时刻关注生产环境，让团队在保持代理速度的同时，无需担心破坏任何东西。
products.description: The faster your team ships with AI, the harder it becomes to keep production stable. Not anymore. Coldtea is an agentic IDE where your coding agents build, visual QA agents catch regressions, and AI monitoring watches production, so your team can keep moving at agent speed without breaking anything

products.name: Soloop
products.tagline: Approval-first Agent OS for solo founders
products.summaryZh: 面向独立开发者的审批优先智能体操作系统
products.descriptionZh: Soloop是一套面向独立创业者的智能体公司构建系统。它通过AI CEO规划、管理与优先级排序，AI CTO负责构建与执行，AI CMO寻找用户并销售，助你从创意直达营收。在将通常需要团队完成的陌生工作委派出去的同时，保留你的判断与主导权。
products.description: Soloop is an agentic company-building system for solo founders. It takes you from idea to revenue with an AI CEO to plan, manage and prioritize, an AI CTO to build and execute, and an AI CMO to find users and sell. Keep your own judgment and ownership while delegating the unfamiliar work that usually requires a team.

products.name: Rindler
products.tagline: Automate the web work your team does by hand
products.summaryZh: 自动化团队手工完成的网页工作。
products.descriptionZh: Rindler自动化处理团队仍需手动完成的重复性网页工作。用简单英语描述需求，Rindler便会访问真实网站，必要时登录，完成任务并返回清晰的结构化数据。设置定时任务后，它会持续运行。不同于让浏览器代理每次自行猜测，Rindler会提前映射每个网站，并在页面变化时修复工作流，确保周期性任务保持可靠。
products.description: Rindler automates the repetitive web work your team still does by hand. Say what you need in plain English, and Rindler goes to the real site, signs in when needed, completes the task, and returns clean structured data. Put it on a schedule and it keeps running. Instead of making a browser agent guess every time, Rindler maps each site ahead of time and repairs workflows when pages change, so recurring tasks stay reliable

products.name: Nitro 4.0
products.tagline: The first human translation platform built for AI agents
products.summaryZh: 首个为AI智能体打造的人工翻译平台
products.descriptionZh: Nitro现已成为首个AI代理可自主下单并支付的人工翻译服务——无需账户、无需API密钥、无需注册。您的代理发送文本，按次付费，由专业母语译者完成翻译——数小时内即可达到出版标准。适用于仍需精准的小型文本：广告、应用更新、邮件序列等。下单流程为机器对机器，翻译过程保持人工完成。支持80多种语言，无套餐，无最低用量要求。
products.description: Nitro is now the first human translation service an AI agent can order and pay for on its own — no account, no API keys, no signup. Your agent sends the text, pays per request, and a professional native speaker translates it — publication-ready in hours. Great for the smaller texts that still need to be right: ads, app updates, email sequences, and more. The ordering is machine-to-machine. The translating stays human. 80+ languages. No plans, no minimums.

products.name: BrowserOS neo
products.tagline: The Missing Browser for Claude, Cowork & Codex
products.summaryZh: Claude、Cowork与Codex的缺失浏览器
products.descriptionZh: BrowserOS neo是一款网络浏览器，并非为你而建，而是为你的AI代理打造。它运行在你的机器上，连接Claude Code、Cowork和Codex，代表你完成实际任务。这很神奇！
products.description: BrowserOS neo is a web browser built NOT for you but for your AI agents. It runs on your machine and connects to Claude Code, Cowork, and Codex finishes real tasks on your behalf. It's magical!

products.name: Progress AI Observability
products.tagline: Trace, evaluate, and improve AI agents in production
products.summaryZh: 在生产环境中追踪、评估并改进AI代理
products.descriptionZh: 在几分钟内调试并监控AI代理故障。追踪每次运行，捕捉传统监控遗漏的幻觉和未基于事实的回答，并准确查看问题所在。减少令牌浪费，提升代理质量，并借助对.NET、Python和JavaScript的支持加快交付。
products.description: Debug and monitor AI agent failures in minutes. Trace every run, catch hallucinations and ungrounded answers that traditional monitoring misses, and see exactly what went wrong. Reduce token waste, improve agent quality, and ship faster with support forNET, Python, and JavaScript.

products.name: Crew
products.tagline: A tiny crew of monsters for your Claude Code agents
products.summaryZh: 为你的Claude Code代理准备的一小队迷你怪物
products.descriptionZh: Crew为每一次Claude Code对话和子代理赋予了一个形象：一个像素小怪兽，沿着屏幕底部行走，工作时挖掘，空闲时睡觉，完成时挥手致意。macOS免费使用。所有数据都不会离开你的Mac。
products.description: Crew gives every Claude Code chat and subagent a body: a little pixel monster that walks along the bottom of your screen, digs while it works, sleeps when it's idle, and waves when it's done. Free for macOS. Nothing ever leaves your Mac.

products.name: Kitesurf
products.tagline: Browser built for agents, running on Cloudflare Workers
products.summaryZh: 为代理构建的浏览器，运行于Cloudflare Workers之上
products.descriptionZh: 使用Kitesurf，Cloudflare的无状态、代理优先浏览器，完全在Workers上运行，配合Browser Run进行截图、HTML提取和自动化操作。
products.description: Use Kitesurf, Cloudflare's stateless, agent-first browser that runs entirely on Workers, with Browser Run for screenshots, HTML extraction, and automation.

products.name: DataBlur
products.tagline: Blur sensitive data on screen before anyone sees it
products.summaryZh: 在任何人看到之前，模糊屏幕上的敏感数据。
products.descriptionZh: DataBlur实时模糊屏幕上的敏感数据——在直播通话、演示和录制过程中。自动检测电子邮件、银行卡和API密钥。100%本地运行：无云端、无AI、无需注册。当检测失败时，它会模糊更多内容，而非更少。
products.description: DataBlur blurs sensitive data on your screen in real time — during live calls, demos and recordings. Auto-detects emails, cards and API keys. 100% local: no cloud, no AI, no signup. When detection fails, it blurs more, not less.

products.name: Merge
products.tagline: AI-native code review assessments
products.summaryZh: AI原生代码审查评估
products.descriptionZh: Merge是一款在线代码评审评估工具，帮助工程团队评估工程判断力。通过Merge，候选人像在实际工作中一样审查PR。随后，我们的AI代理实时处理PR评论，模拟真实工程师的行为。最后，我们评估缺陷覆盖率、沟通能力、PR质量及令牌使用效率。
products.description: Merge is a online code review assessment that helps engineering teams assess engineering judgement. With Merge, candidates review a PR, just like on the job. Then, our AI agent addresses PR comments in realtime, simulating a real engineer. At the end, we assess bug coverage, communication, PR quality, and token use efficiency.

products.name: HAR
products.tagline: Open Source harness for multi-agent coding workflows
products.summaryZh: 开源多智能体编码工作流工具
products.descriptionZh: HAR是一个开源的、与代理无关的框架，用于构建多代理编码工作流。可在任何代码库上并行运行一组编码代理，具备确定性验证门、可验证证明，以及对每个代理的全面可观测性，所有功能均可扩展并可根据您自己的工作流和工具进行定制。
products.description: HAR is an open-source, agent-agnostic framework for building multi-agent coding workflows. Run a fleet of coding agents in parallel on any repository, with deterministic validation gates, verifiable proof, and full observability across every agent, all extensible and customizable to your own workflow and tooling.

products.name: Troopr AI Scrum Master
products.tagline: Writes your standup from real work. Remembers your team.
products.summaryZh: 根据实际工作内容撰写你的每日站会报告。记住你的团队成员。
products.descriptionZh: Troopr加入你的站会，从真实的Jira、GitHub和Slack活动中记录每个人的更新，并标记出不一致之处。它构建团队工作方式的记忆，使每次站会更加准确。
products.description: Troopr joins your standup, writes each person's update from real Jira, GitHub, and Slack activity, and flags what doesn't add up. It builds a memory of how your team works, so every standup gets more accurate.

products.name: The new Firecrawl MCP
products.tagline: Agent-ready web context for any MCP client.
products.summaryZh: 适用于任何MCP客户端的Agent就绪Web上下文。
products.descriptionZh: 全新Firecrawl MCP现已推出。每次/search、/scrape及/interact调用，上下文使用量减少50%。同时，通过OAuth实现人类用户的即时接入，并为代理提供无密钥版本。即刻在任何MCP客户端中获取适用于代理的网络上下文！
products.description: Introducing the new Firecrawl MCP. It now uses 50% less context on every /search, /scrape, and /interact call. Plus, instant onboarding with OAuth for humans and a keyless version for agents. Get agent-ready web context in any MCP client today!

products.name: Whop CLI
products.tagline: Run your entire business from the terminal
products.summaryZh: 在终端中运营你的整个业务
products.descriptionZh: 现在，你在Whop仪表板上能做的所有事情，都可以通过终端完成。建立业务、创建产品、设定价格、投放广告、转移资金、发布应用、查看数据，一切尽在掌握。你可以自己操作，或者交给像Claude、Cursor或Codex这样的AI代理。整个Whop API，一个二进制文件，你的业务完全可编程。你无需成为开发高手，只需告诉代理你的需求，它便会为你执行命令。就这么简单。
products.description: Everything you can do from your Whop dashboard now runs from a terminal. Build a business, create products, set pricing, run ads, move money, ship apps, and read the numbers. Run it yourself, or hand it to an AI agent like Claude, Cursor, or Codex. The entire Whop API, one binary, your business is completely programmable. You don't need to be a dev wizard. Just tell your agent what you want, and it runs the commands for you. It's that easy.

products.name: AndroMeld
products.tagline: Bring a continuity-style experience to Android and Mac
products.summaryZh: 为Android和Mac带来连贯性的使用体验
products.descriptionZh: AndroMeld为Android和Mac带来类Continuity的体验。将多个Android应用镜像到独立、可调整大小、接近原生的Mac窗口中，接续手机上已打开的应用，并通过键盘和触控板手势进行控制。在Finder中浏览Android存储，同步通知和剪贴板，通过蓝牙开启手机热点。支持通过USB或Wi-Fi连接任何Android 16+设备，并提供免费Web应用。
products.description: AndroMeld brings a Continuity-style experience to Android and Mac. Mirror multiple Android apps in separate, resizable, native-like Mac windows, hand off the app already open on your phone, and control it with keyboard & trackpad gestures. Browse Android storage in Finder, sync notifications and clipboard, and turn on your phone’s hotspot over Bluetooth. Support any Android 16+ devices connect by USB or Wi-Fi, with a free Web App available.

products.name: Prompt Bridge
products.tagline: Keep AI Context Portable
products.summaryZh: 保持AI上下文可移植
products.descriptionZh: Prompt Bridge是一款免费的Chrome扩展程序，能在所有主流AI平台间携带完整的AI对话上下文——再也不必重新开始对话。
products.description: Prompt Bridge is the free Chrome extension that carries your full AI conversation context across all major AI platforms — never restart a thread again.

products.name: Blueberry
products.tagline: Stop Ghosting People You Actually Like
products.summaryZh: 别再对你真正喜欢的人玩消失
products.descriptionZh: Blueberry是一款mac菜单栏应用，能以你的口吻起草iMessage回复。在你点击发送之前，不会有任何内容发出。非常适合习惯性已读不回和不太会发短信的人！
products.description: Blueberry is a mac menu bar app that drafts responses to your iMessages in your voice. Nothing goes out until you click send. Great for the chronic ghosters and terrible texters!

products.name: StepShot
products.tagline: AI that turns real workflows into step-by-step guides
products.summaryZh: 将真实工作流程转化为分步指南的AI
products.descriptionZh: StepShot是一款AI驱动的文档工具，能在您工作时将真实的屏幕操作流程转化为精美的分步指南。它捕捉点击和键入操作；本地AI截取屏幕截图、撰写说明，并解释哪些操作应保留或跳过。您可以编辑、标注、重新排序和编辑每个步骤，然后导出为PDF、Markdown或HTML格式。它在您的Mac上本地运行，无需账户或产品遥测，而可选的云端AI润色则使用您自己的兼容OpenAI的提供商。
products.description: StepShot is an AI-powered documentation tool that turns real on-screen workflows into polished step-by-step guides as you work. It captures clicks and typing; local AI frames screenshots, writes instructions, and explains which actions to keep or skip. Edit, annotate, reorder, and redact every step, then export to PDF, Markdown, or HTML. It runs locally on your Mac with no account or product telemetry, while optional cloud AI polishing uses your own OpenAI-compatible provider.

products.name: Rescript for Desktop
products.tagline: A free, open source, Descript alternative. Runs on-device.
products.summaryZh: 免费、开源的Descript替代品。在设备端运行。
products.descriptionZh: 🎬 一款基于转录文本的开源视频编辑器，运行于浏览器中。通过编辑转录文本即可轻松剪辑视频。完全在您的设备或浏览器中运行：本地、免费且离线！现已推出Mac OS、Windows和Linux桌面应用。自上次发布以来，我们新增了：- 更精准的转录功能- 桌面应用及深色模式- 支持5种语言- 导出格式及音频导出能力- 转录文本和字幕的导入/导出…以及更多！
products.description: 🎬 An open source, transcript-based video editor that lives in the browser. Edit videos by simply editing the transcript text. Runs fully on your device or in the browser: Local, free and offline! Now available as a Desktop app on Mac OS, Windows and Linux. Since the last launch we've added: - More accurate transcriptions - Desktop app + Dark mode - Support for 5 languages - Export formats + ability to export as audio - Importing/exporting transcripts and captions.. and more!

products.name: Reference
products.tagline: Local semantic search for AI agents
products.summaryZh: 面向AI代理的本地语义搜索
products.descriptionZh: Reference是面向AI代理的本地语义搜索工具，适用于文件和代码。无需云端，所有数据均保留在本地机器上。询问“我在这里是如何实现速率限制的”，即可获得实际代码，精确到具体函数，而非泛泛建议。实时索引随保存更新，支持代码感知分块（基于tree-sitter），并内置MCP服务器（/search、/explain、/find_similar、/check_doc_drift），让Claude Code获得精确引用的结果，而非在grep循环中浪费token。
products.description: Reference is local semantic search for your files and code, built for AI agents. No cloud, nothing leaves your machine. Ask it "how did I implement rate limiting here" and get your actual code back, cited down to the exact function, not generic advice. Live index that updates as you save, code-aware chunking (tree-sitter), and a built-in MCP server (/search, /explain, /find_similar, /check_doc_drift)so Claude Code gets precise cited results instead of burning tokens on grep loops.
